teaser.en: A wild ginger of the forest floor, given the same snake-warning name as the blood lily.
teaser.sw: Tangawizi pori ya sakafu ya msitu, iliyopewa jina lilelile la onyo la nyoka kama *blood lily*.
teaser.dg: Tangawizi ya weruni inayomera photsi tsakani, iriyohewa dzina ra kuonya ra nyoka dza ra *blood lily*.

summary.en: This mnazi wa nyoka is a wild ginger of the coastal forest. Digo speakers give it the same name as the blood lily, a 'snake's coconut tree', to mark it as poisonous.
summary.sw: Mnazi wa nyoka huu ni tangawizi pori ya misitu ya pwani. Wadigo huupa jina lilelile la *blood lily*, 'mnazi wa nyoka', ili kuuonyesha kuwa una sumu.
summary.dg: *Mnazi wa nyoka* uhu ni tangawizi ya weruni ya matsaka ga pwani. Adigo anaupha dzina mwenga na *blood lily*, 'mnazi wa nyoka', kuonyesa kukala ni wa sumu.

about.en: This *mnazi wa nyoka* is a wild ginger. It grows from fleshy underground rhizomes and puts up leafy shoots in the rainy season, with broad leaves on a short false stem. The flowers appear close to the ground, often before the leaves, and are delicate and short-lived, as in other *Siphonochilus*. In the dry season the shoots die back and the plant waits underground.
about.sw: *Mnazi wa nyoka* huu ni tangawizi pori. Unaota kutoka kwenye viazi (mashina ya chini ya ardhi) vyenye nyama, na hutoa machipukizi yenye majani wakati wa mvua, yenye majani mapana juu ya shina bandia fupi. Maua huchanua karibu na ardhi, mara nyingi kabla ya majani, na ni laini na hudumu kwa muda mfupi, kama ilivyo kwa *Siphonochilus* wengine. Wakati wa kiangazi machipukizi hunyauka na mmea husubiri chini ya ardhi.
about.dg: *Mnazi wa nyoka* uhu ni tangawizi ya weruni. Unamera kula kpwa mizi minono ya tsini ganayokala dza viazi (*rhizomes*), na wakati wa mwaka unalavya mihi michache yenye makodza, yenye makodza mapana dzulu ya kolo ra handzo rifupi. Maruwa ganatuluka phephi na photsi, mara nyinji kabla ya makodza, na ni malaini na gasigokala muda mure, dza kpwa *Siphonochilus* wanjina. Wakati wa kazikazi mihi ichi inanyala, na mmea unagodza tsini.

where.en: It is a plant of the coastal forests of Kenya and Tanzania, growing in the shade of the forest floor.
where.sw: Ni mmea wa misitu ya pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania, unaoota kivulini kwenye sakafu ya msitu.
where.dg: Ni mmea wa matsaka ga pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania, unaomera chivuri-vurini photsi tsakani.

culture.en: Pakia gives this name as an example of animal names used as warnings. The snake marks the plant as poisonous, like a snake.
culture.sw: Pakia analitoa jina hili kama mfano wa majina ya wanyama yanayotumika kama maonyo. Nyoka huuonyesha mmea kuwa na sumu, kama nyoka.
culture.dg: Pakia analavya dzina hiri dza mfwano wa madzina ga nyama ganayohumirwa kuonya. Nyoka inaonyesa kukala mmea uhu ni wa sumu, dza nyoka.

names.en: *Mnazi wa nyoka* means 'coconut tree of the snake'. The leafy shoot grows like a small coconut palm, and *nyoka*, snake, warns of poison. Pakia records the same name for *Scadoxus multiflorus*, the blood lily. It is not related to the coconut. There is no English or Swahili name in the sources.
names.sw: *Mnazi wa nyoka* maana yake ni 'mnazi wa nyoka'. Chipukizi lenye majani hukua kama mnazi mdogo, na *nyoka* huonya juu ya sumu. Pakia anaandika jina hilo hilo kwa *Scadoxus multiflorus*, yaani *blood lily*. Hauna uhusiano na mnazi. Vyanzo havitoi jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili.
names.dg: *Mnazi wa nyoka* rina mana ya 'mnazi wa nyoka'. Mihi yenye makodza inamera dza mnazi mdide, na *nyoka*, yani nyoka, inaonya kukala ni wa sumu. Pakia anaandika dzina hiri hiri kpwa *Scadoxus multiflorus*, *blood lily*. Tauhusiana na mnazi. Kpwenye vitabu takuna dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili.

reason.en: Blood lily, which shares the name
reason.dg: *Blood lily*, ambao una dzina mwenga na mmea uhu

reason.sw: Manjano, mmea mwingine wa familia ya tangawizi
reason.dg: Mandano, mmea wanjina wa jamii ya tangawizi

reason.en: The coconut palm in its name
